Nature’s Veil.duration: until the end of your next turn

beast-master.summary: A ranger bonded to a primal beast that fights at their command.

Primal Companion.summary: Summon a primal beast (Land, Sea or Sky) that obeys you and acts on your turn. It only Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action, or give up one of your attacks, to have it act. Revive it within an hour with a Magic action and a spell slot; swap it on a Long Rest.

options.name: Beast of the Land
options.summary: Medium; AC 13 + WIS; HP 5 + 5 × Ranger level (d8 Hit Dice); Speed 40 ft, climb 40 ft; Darkvision 60 ft. Beast's Strike: 1d8 + 2 + WIS; a 20-ft straight run first adds 1d6 and knocks Large or smaller Prone.

options.name: Beast of the Sea
options.summary: Medium; AC 13 + WIS; HP 5 + 5 × Ranger level (d8 Hit Dice); Speed 5 ft, swim 60 ft; Darkvision 90 ft; breathes air and water. Beast's Strike: 1d6 + 2 + WIS and Grapples (escape DC = your spell save DC).

options.name: Beast of the Sky
options.summary: Small; AC 13 + WIS; HP 4 + 4 × Ranger level (d6 Hit Dice); Speed 10 ft, fly 60 ft; Darkvision 60 ft; flying away never provokes. Beast's Strike: 1d4 + 3 + WIS Slashing.

Exceptional Training.summary: When a Bonus Action commands your beast, it can also Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help with its own Bonus Action, and its damaging hits may deal Force damage instead.

Bestial Fury.summary: Your beast makes Beast's Strike twice when commanded to use it, and its first hit each turn on your Hunter's Mark target adds that spell's bonus damage as Force.

Share Spells.summary: A spell you cast on yourself can also affect your beast if it's within 30 ft.

fey-wanderer.summary: A ranger touched by fey magic who blends charm with terrifying psychic strikes.

Dreadful Strikes.summary: Weapon hits can deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage (1d6 from Ranger level 11); each creature takes it at most once per turn.

Fey Wanderer Spells.summary: Subclass spells always prepared, gained at Ranger levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17. You also get a harmless fey quirk, chosen or rolled on a d6 table.

Otherworldly Glamour.summary: Add your WIS mod (min +1) to Charisma checks, and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

Beguiling Twist.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed or Frightened. When you or a creature you see within 120 ft succeeds on one, your Reaction makes another creature within 120 ft save WIS or be Charmed or Frightened (your pick) for 1 minute, saving again each turn end.

Fey Reinforcements.summary: Summon Fey needs no Material component, can be cast once per Long Rest without a slot, and can skip Concentration, lasting 1 minute instead.

Misty Wanderer.summary: Cast Misty Step without a slot WIS mod times (min 1) per Long Rest. Any casting can carry one willing creature within 5 ft, which lands within 5 ft of you.

gloom-stalker.summary: A ranger who ambushes foes from the dark with shadow magic and dread.

Dread Ambusher.summary: +10 ft Speed on your first turn of each combat. Once per turn a weapon hit can add 2d6 Psychic (WIS mod uses, min 1, per Long Rest). Add your WIS mod to Initiative rolls.

Gloom Stalker Spells.summary: Subclass spells always prepared, gained at Ranger levels 3, 5, 9, 13 and 17.

Umbral Sight.summary: Gain 60 ft Darkvision (+60 ft if you have it). While fully in Darkness, you're Invisible to creatures that use Darkvision to see you.

Iron Mind.summary: Proficiency in Wisdom saves; if you already have it, pick Intelligence or Charisma saves instead.

Stalker's Flurry.summary: Dread Ambusher's Psychic damage rises to 2d8, and each time you use it you may add Sudden Strike or Mass Fear.

options.name: Sudden Strike
options.summary: Make one more attack with that weapon at another creature within 5 ft of the first target and within range.

options.name: Mass Fear
options.summary: The target and everyone within 10 ft of it save WIS or are Frightened until your next turn starts.
options.duration: until the start of your next turn

Shadowy Dodge.summary: Reaction when a creature rolls to attack you: give the roll Disadvantage, then teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see, hit or miss.
